title: エイシンフラッシュ登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash presents me a full three-year timetable for her racing career before the Twinkle Series even gets underway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's not only aiming for the Classic Triple Crown, but also the title of Twin Tenno Sho Champion… With such airtight plans, we must work hard to make them a reality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though she intends to return to Germany upon completing her goals, she seems completely committed to racing in the meantime.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My three years with the straightlaced, no-nonsense Eishin Flash has begun. By adhering to her perfect schedule, she's aiming to become a version of herself she can be proud of.
